records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom is the short header. Sera uses his given name in her first attempts to speak.
Fernando Dias is the speaker who condemns Espinosa's conduct and sees no reason for leniency.
Manuel Almeida is the crewmate whose own experience in Sao Jorge leads to his vow against slavers.
Sera Shahrbaraz is the short header. Sera Altos Shahrbaraz remains the catalogue form. Use the inherited unidentified caption before her portrait and name appear.
Geronimo Espinosa is the short header. The catalogue preserves the separate de field in Geronimo de Espinosa.
Shopkeeper is the natural role label for the shop owner from the Square. His testimony and later request establish no other occupation or title.
Port Worker fits the source's familiar label for someone working at the departure office. This variant relays a guildmaster's request.
Port Worker is the same source occupation for the villager who confronts Espinosa about his family's disappearance.
Port Worker covers the same departure-office role in this port. The source's regional field describes the variant and is not a nameplate title.
Innkeeper identifies the woman by her occupation without turning the source form of address into a familial relationship.
